sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been fled to quash the order dated 19.4.2023 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, (POCSO Act), District - Bijnor in Case Crime No. 354 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 4 of POCSO Act, Police Statio - Kotwali City, District - Bijnor.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge, (POCSO Act), District - Bijnor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that an FIR has been lodged by the first informant with the allegation that on 28.6.2020 the applicant had enticed away his daughter and her daughter under influence of applicant/accused eloped alongwith cash rupees and ornaments.
The informant tried to search out but was unable to find her daughter.

sentences.text: Submission of the learned counsel for the applicant is that order passed on 19.4.2023 by the trial court is without application of judicial mind and is liable to be set aside.

5. It it is next submitted that due to inadvertence some important questions were left out to be asked from PW-1 & PW-3, hence the applicant moved an application before the court of Special Judge,
(POCSO Act), District - Bijnor under Section 311 Cr.P.C. on 9.2.2023 with a prayer to summon PW-1 & PW-3 for further examination which are required to be asked from PW-1 & PW-3 and are necessary for disposal of the case.

6. Learned AGA opposed the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that the application filed by the applicant under Section 311 Cr.P.C. is based on false and fabricated facts and has been filed with the intention to linger on the trial.
He next submitted that PW-1 an,d PW-3 have already been cross examined by the accused.
The trial court has rightly rejected the application of the applicant and the order dated 19.4.2023 passed by the trial court is just and proper.

7. Considering rival submission of the parties and after perusing the record, I come to the conclusion that there is no illegality in the order dated 19.4.2023 passed by the trial court and order is just and proper.
No question or facts remained/left to ask from PW-1 and PW-3.
An ambiguous prayer has been made in the application that some facts left to be asked from the PW-1 and PW-3.
Since, PW-1 an,d PW-3
have already been examined by the applicant.
Now it appears only to delay the trial application under Section 311 Cr.P.C. has been moved.
8. Prima facie, no case is made out to be interfered by this Court.
9. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed with the aforesaid observation.
